output:
I'll start by looking at the workspace layout and the docs.

My last call was truncated before it ran, so I'm reissuing it.

Next I'll make one copy of the package per candidate fix and replay each to count the lost hits.

Each of the four single fixes turns misses into hits. I'll apply them to `/app/shelfmark` and replay with all of them together.

I found four defects in the shipped code and fixed all of them. I wrote `/app/cache-report.json` and `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.

I measured each count by replaying the logged traffic with that one fix on its own. The replay started at the 2.4.0 start-up (`--since 2027-05-03T14:00:05.000Z`) and I counted requests logged `miss` that the fixed copy served as `hit`. With the original code that replay matches the log exactly (0 differences), so the counts come from the code as shipped.

| Class | File:line (original) | Defect | Requests | First |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key-params` | `shelfmark/keys.py:19` | Parameters starting with `utm_` were only left out when listed in `ignore_params`. | 764 | `r0009011` |
| `key-vary` | `shelfmark/locale.py:38` | A match on the primary language subtag returned the client's range (for example `en-gb`) instead of the supported locale, so one locale got many keys. | 1418 | `r0006627` |
| `invalidation` | `shelfmark/cache.py:23` | The purge prefix `books|12` also matched `books|120` and `books|1203`. | 16 | `r0007206` |
| `ttl` | `shelfmark/config.py:39` | A whole-number ttl was read as milliseconds instead of seconds. Revision 43 wrote the search ttl as `600`, so search entries lasted 0.6 s from 20:00 on May 3. | 274 | `r0011087` |

The fixes keep the same line numbers, so the report's line numbers also match the edited files.

- **Verification:** `python3 -m unittest` passes (30 tests). With all four fixes applied, the replay differs from the log on 3,164 requests, which is expected because the log reflects the defective release.
- **Not covered:** I found no defects in routing, capacity or clock handling, but that rests on reading the code and the logs. Nothing could be checked against a ground truth for those classes.

command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./logs -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; ls -la logs logs/access | head -50; cat docs/triage.md; wc -l shelfmark/*.py docs/*
cd /app; cat docs/cache.md docs/changelog.md docs/config.md docs/locale.md docs/operations.md docs/overview.md; cat -n shelfmark/*.py
cd /app; sed -n 20,70p docs/operations.md; cat docs/overview.md; cat -n shelfmark/__init__.py shelfmark/cache.py; sed -n 1,45p shelfmark/config.py
cd /app; cat logs/config.log logs/deploy.log logs/ops.log logs/service.log | cut -c1-250; head -5 logs/upstream.log; cat tools/replay.py; ls config/history; cat config/cache.toml

cd /app; for f in 41 42 43; do echo == $f; cat config/history/r0$f.toml; done; python3 tools/replay.py --diff | tail -5; python3 tools/replay.py --since 2027-05-03T14:00:05.000Z --diff | tail -3; cat tests/support.py | head -40; python3 -m unittest 2>&1 | tail -5

cd /app; python3 --version; cat logs/access/*.log | awk '{print $3, $4}' | sed -E 's/[0-9]+/N/g; s/\?.*//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -30; grep -h -v ' GET /\(books\|authors\|search\)' logs/access/*.log | awk '{print $3,$4,$6}' | sed -E 's/[0-9]+/N/g' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20
cd /app; grep -hE ' GET /(books|authors)/(0|[0-9]*[^0-9 ?])' logs/access/*.log | head; grep -hE ' GET /(books|authors)/0' logs/access/*.log | head -3
cd /tmp; python3 mk.py && for n in utm loc purge ttl; do bash measure.sh $n; done

cd /app; python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
for f,old,new in [
("shelfmark/keys.py",'        if name in cfg.ignore_params:','        if name in cfg.ignore_params or name.startswith("utm_"):'),
("shelfmark/locale.py","                return rng\n    return default","                return loc\n    return default"),
("shelfmark/cache.py",'prefix = f"{route}|{ident}"','prefix = f"{route}|{ident}|"'),
("shelfmark/config.py","        return int(value)\n","        return int(value) * 1000\n")]:
    t=open(f).read(); assert t.count(old)==1; open(f,'w').write(t.replace(old,new))
EOF
grep -n 'utm_\|return loc\|ident}|\|\* 1000' shelfmark/*.py; python3 -m unittest 2>&1 | tail -3; python3 tools/replay.py --since 2027-05-03T14:00:05.000Z --diff | grep -c 'logged=miss replay=hit'; python3 tools/replay.py --since 2027-05-03T14:00:05.000Z --diff | tail -1

cd /app; sed -n 30,40p shelfmark/locale.py; sed -n 36,40p shelfmark/config.py; for n in utm loc purge ttl; do echo $n $(grep -c 'logged=miss replay=hit' /tmp/out_$n.txt) $(grep 'logged=miss replay=hit' /tmp/out_$n.txt | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f1); done
